usage: Drink in combat as an action; gain fire resistance for about an hour (PC turns).

srd.text:
_Potion, Uncommon_

When you drink this potion, you gain Resistance to one damage type for 1 hour. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly from the options below.

| d10 | Damage Type |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Acid |
| 2 | Cold |
| 3 | Fire |
| 4 | Force |
| 5 | Lightning |
| 6 | Necrotic |
| 7 | Poison |
| 8 | Psychic |
| 9 | Radiant |
| 10 | Thunder |
